parameters.query:
SELECT json_build_object(
  'totals', (SELECT json_build_object(
    'total', count(*),
    'open', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status NOT IN ('resolved','closed','disputed')),
    'urgent_high', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status NOT IN ('resolved','closed','disputed') AND severity IN ('high','urgent')),
    'in_progress', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='in_progress'),
    'sla_breach', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('assigned','in_progress') AND assigned_at IS NOT NULL AND assigned_at < now() - CASE severity WHEN 'urgent' THEN INTERVAL '2 days' WHEN 'high' THEN INTERVAL '5 days' WHEN 'medium' THEN INTERVAL '14 days' ELSE INTERVAL '30 days' END),
    'resolved_30d', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('resolved','closed') AND resolved_at > now() - INTERVAL '30 days')
  ) FROM aftercare_incidents),
  'by_severity', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.ord) FROM (
    SELECT severity, count(*)::int AS open_count,
      CASE severity WHEN 'urgent' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS ord
    FROM aftercare_incidents WHERE status NOT IN ('resolved','closed','disputed')
    GROUP BY severity
  ) t), '[]'::json),
  'by_category', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.open_count DESC) FROM (
    SELECT category, count(*)::int AS open_count
    FROM aftercare_incidents WHERE status NOT IN ('resolved','closed','disputed') AND category IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY category
  ) t), '[]'::json),
  'recent_open', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.reported_at DESC) FROM (
    SELECT i.id::text AS incident_id, i.severity, i.status, i.category, i.responsible_trade,
      i.assigned_to, i.assigned_at, i.reported_at,
      substring(i.description for 100) AS desc_preview,
      p.id::text AS project_id, p.name AS project_name,
      floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - i.reported_at))/86400)::int AS days_open,
      CASE i.severity WHEN 'urgent' THEN 2 WHEN 'high' THEN 5 WHEN 'medium' THEN 14 ELSE 30 END AS sla_days,
      CASE WHEN i.assigned_at IS NOT NULL THEN floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - i.assigned_at))/86400)::int ELSE NULL END AS days_assigned
    FROM aftercare_incidents i
    JOIN projects p ON p.id = i.project_id
    WHERE i.status NOT IN ('resolved','closed','disputed')
    ORDER BY CASE i.severity WHEN 'urgent' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, i.reported_at ASC
    LIMIT 25
  ) t), '[]'::json)
) AS report;
